content.short: Samurai Shodown R is a mobile MMORPG on Sui featuring dynamic NFTs and zkLogin for seamless onboarding for users.
content.description: Samurai Shodown R is a next-generation mobile MMORPG built natively on the high-performance Sui blockchain, developed by Lumiwave in collaboration with the legendary Japanese game studio SNK. The game brings the classic weapon-based fighting franchise into the Web3 era, featuring intense PvP combat, clan-based quests, and an expansive virtual world. Samurai Shodown R utilizes Sui's advanced technology—including zkLogin for easy social sign-ins and dynamic NFTs—to provide a seamless and immersive experience for both traditional and Web3 gamers across the entire ecosystem.
content.meta: Samurai Shodown R offers high-action MMORPG gameplay and dynamic NFT ownership on Sui. Discover Samurai Shodown R and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
